2608.23799.title: Restoring Without Forgetting: Continual Learning Across Image Degradations
2608.23799.paper_summary: Recent progress in image restoration has converged on all-in-one architectures that jointly handle multiple degradations within a single network. These methods are effective on static benchmarks but target a closed-world setting that assumes simultaneous access to every target degradation at training time. In practice, degradations are encountered sequentially as field-deployed systems progressively face new environmental conditions, and historical training data is often unavailable due to privacy or storage constraints. Accommodating a new degradation then requires either retraining on the union of all prior data, which is often costly or infeasible, or fine-tuning, which causes catastrophic forgetting. We formulate multi-degradation image restoration as a continual domain-incremental learning problem, in which degradations arrive incrementally and prior data is unavailable. Our proposed Restoring without Forgetting (RwF) framework learns a lightweight adapter for each new degradation, eliminating forgetting by construction at a fraction of the cost of dedicated per-domain networks. To isolate degradation learning from dataset variation, we construct a benchmark spanning five degradation domains under shared image content. At test time, an unsupervised routing mechanism identifies the appropriate restoration path for unknown inputs without requiring domain labels. Across the five-domain sequence, RwF improves final average PSNR over naive sequential fine-tuning by 15.25 dB and 11.83 dB on the Restormer and NAFNet backbones, respectively. The framework transfers to eleven canonical real-degradation benchmarks (3,465 images) at 89.5% routing accuracy with only a +0.94 dB oracle PSNR gap, establishing, to our knowledge, the first systematic baseline for continual multi-degradation image restoration.
2608.23799.paper_summary_zh: 最近在影像修復方面的進展已經集中於全能架構，這些架構在單一網路中共同處理多種退化。這些方法在靜態基準上是有效的，但目標是封閉世界設定，假設在訓練時可以同時訪問每一個目標退化。實際上，退化是逐步遇到的，因為現場部署的系統逐漸面對新的環境條件，並且由於隱私或儲存限制，歷史訓練數據通常無法獲得。因此，適應新的退化要麼需要在所有先前數據的聯合上重新訓練，這通常是昂貴或不可行的，要麼需要微調，這會導致災難性遺忘。我們將多退化影像修復公式化為一個持續的領域增量學習問題，其中退化是逐步到達的，且先前的數據是不可用的。我們提出的無遺忘修復（RwF）框架為每個新的退化學習一個輕量級適配器，通過結構消除遺忘，成本僅為專用每個領域網路的一小部分。為了將退化學習與數據集變化隔離，我們構建了一個基準，涵蓋五個退化領域，並共享影像內容。在測試時，一個無監督的路由機制識別未知輸入的適當修復路徑，而無需領域標籤。在這五個領域序列中，RwF 在 naive 逐序微調上分別提高了 Restormer 和 NAFNet 骨幹的最終平均 PSNR 15.25 dB 和 11.83 dB。該框架在十一個經典的真實退化基準（3,465 張影像）上以 89.5% 的路由準確率轉移，僅有 +0.94 dB 的 oracle PSNR 差距，建立了我們所知的第一個持續多退化影像修復的系統基準。
